pages.title: Antiproton Bundle
pages.text: A magnetic bottle the size of a thumb with a pale pink knot of light at its centre: billions of antiprotons circling, never touching the glass.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Decelerator catches them from collisions at nearly light speed and brakes them lap after lap until a trap can hold them.
